shortDescription: Create, update, or delete an edge router

options.name: attributes
options.description: A list of role attributes prefixed with a \#hash mark.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: provision the router in a NetFoundry datacenter by locationCode or ID from netfoundry_info.data_centers (default provider is AWS)

options.name: linkListener
options.description: listen for router links on 80/tcp; all hosted routers (non-null datacenter) have link listeners

options.name: name
options.description: the name of the edge router

options.name: network
options.description: The dictionary describing the Network on which to operate from netfoundry_info.network.

options.name: provider
options.description: limit potential datacenter name matches to the specified cloud provider

options.name: rotateKey
options.description: rotate and return the new key for registration of a NetFoundry Linux VM; requires state=present and null datacenter i.e. NA to NF-hosted routers

options.name: tunnelerEnabled
options.description: enable tunneler intercept and hosting features for this router

options.name: wait
options.description: seconds to wait for specified status (see async example)
